query: Which cryptographic and privacy-preserving protocols (secure aggregation, federated averaging variants, differential privacy params) enable cross-site model training while preserving utility and compliance?

response.query: Which cryptographic and privacy-preserving protocols (secure aggregation, federated averaging variants, differential privacy params) enable cross-site model training while preserving utility and compliance?
response.answer: Federated averaging, secure aggregation, and differential privacy enable cross-site model training while preserving utility and compliance. Homomorphic encryption also supports privacy-preserving computation. These methods protect data privacy without sharing sensitive information.
